Opus 5.5 is said to arrive Tuesday, 20 percent cheaper than Opus 5

Accounts circulating since Sunday put the model at $4 and $20 per million tokens, testing under the codename claude-wafer-eap and strongest at 3D and front-end work.

https://theaipost.net/story/opus55-rumour/

UN panel says agent safeguards cannot wait for scientific certainty

The Independent International Scientific Panel on AI published its first thematic brief, arguing that loss-of-control risk may justify acting before the science is settled.

https://theaipost.net/story/un-agent-panel/

Amazon blocks Meta's Muse agent from shopping on its store

A popup told Muse users on Sunday that access by an unauthorised AI agent breaks Amazon's terms, GeekWire reported. The Verge said it asked Meta for comment.

https://theaipost.net/story/amazon-muse-block/

OpenAI and Anthropic discussed testing each other's models, The Information says

Five financial wire accounts relayed the report on Monday. All of them rest on the same outlet, and neither company has commented.

https://theaipost.net/story/openai-anthropic-crosstest/

Meta says Petal subsea cable to carry 1 petabit a second

The cable will run about 7,000km between France and the United States and is expected in service in 2029, Meta said on Monday.

https://theaipost.net/story/meta-petal-cable/

DeepSeek is training a 2-trillion-parameter model, The Information says

Liang Wenfeng told investors that training on Chinese chips has to work, according to summaries of the report. DeepSeek has not commented.

https://theaipost.net/story/c045f575d/

Nvidia's Huang says AI has 0% chance of ending humanity

In a CBS Sunday Morning interview, the Nvidia chief executive dismissed AI extinction fears and said the industry does not need new safety regulation, Nvidia and The Verge reported.

https://theaipost.net/story/c828665c1/

SoftBank seeks $11 billion in bonds to boost OpenAI stake
https://theaipost.net/story/c25c3402c/

Bessent proposes US-China notification system for AI incidents

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has proposed a mechanism for the US and China to notify each other of AI incidents that reach the level of a national-security concern, two accounts reported.

https://theaipost.net/story/c1bb637ba/

Benchmarks split on speed between Laya and TypeSafe's Jev
https://theaipost.net/story/c24f3f7a5/
